## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the focused checks run and their results. Identify untested platforms.

## Checklist

- [ ] Version, schema, application ID and storage compatibility are intentional.
- [ ] Dependency pins, hashes, notices and documentation agree.
- [ ] No credentials, signing material, user data or personal paths are included.
- [ ] Required third-party attribution is preserved.
- [ ] Every new commit has a meaningful title and description.
- [ ] Runtime package layouts and the single SHA256SUM.txt contract are preserved.
